name: Clever regrouping (pair to round numbers)
definition: A long sum is much easier if you reorder it so pieces combine into round numbers. Pairing the first with the last, or grouping terms that cancel, turns a page of arithmetic into a line of it. The point is choosing the grouping before you start adding.
recognizeWhen: add all the numbers from one to some total
a long chain of plus and minus signs
the numbers are chosen so that pairs make ten or one hundred
several fractions that look like they will cancel
misconceptions: I added left to right and made an arithmetic slip halfway through.
I paired the numbers up but then forgot to count how many pairs there were.
I noticed a middle number left over and included it in a pair anyway.
